name: QuestionPunk
description: Official hosted MCP server for QuestionPunk, a survey platform with AI-moderated voice and chat interviews. Create a study or start one from a template, edit questions and display logic on a draft, and publish it when you ask. With permission to read responses, pull response counts, single responses, reports, cross-tabs and CSV or Excel exports. OAuth sign-in; works on every plan, Free included, and the plan's limits apply.
author: QuestionPunk
